attempts.text:
The plan rescues everyone who can be reached. The 3 adults at Bidur farm and Trishuli farm are deferred because no usable road reaches them. Total cost is 180 minutes of driving plus 60 in penalties, so **240**.

**Which roads can be used**
- Blocked or closed: Likhu–Jwalamukhi, Uttargaya–Likhu, Galchhi–Suryagadhi, Tarkeshwar–Suryagadhi and Shivapuri–Suryagadhi.
- Unreachable: Bidur farm and Trishuli farm connect only to each other through Tarkeshwar care home. That group has no usable road to the rest of the network. Their 3 adults are deferred, at 20 each (60).
- Tadi temple is not a designated evacuation point, so nobody is dropped there.

**Is each rescue cheaper than deferring?**

| Group | Rescue cost | Deferral penalty |
|---|---|---|
| 4 children at Kalika village | 56 min round trip | 240 |
| 7 children at Gosaikunda school | two 22 min round trips | 420 |
| 3 adults at Shivapuri farm | 22 min round trip | 60 |
| 3 adults at Galchhi school | about 32 min | 60 |
| 3 adults at Dhunche school | about 10 min | 60 |
| 2 elderly at Suryagadhi temple | about 16 min | 100 |

Every reachable group costs less to rescue than to defer, so all of them are rescued.

**How the cars are used**
- **car1 (114 min):**
  - Galchhi trip (32): 3 adults from Galchhi plus 1 from Dhunche to Myagang shelter.
  - Mixed trip (26): 2 elderly from Suryagadhi plus 2 adults from Dhunche to Myagang shelter.
  - Kalika trip (56): 4 children to Myagang shelter.
- **car2 (66 min):**
  - Gosaikunda trips (44): all 7 children to Uttargaya hospital in two trips.
  - Shivapuri trip (22): 3 adults to Uttargaya hospital.
